verdict.rationale: RevenueCat is a subscription monetization and billing platform, so usage visibility and spend alerts are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows subscription charts, purchase-event webhooks and customer purchase data. Nothing documents current-cycle usage metering, real-time accrued cost, customer-facing usage views, or threshold alerts before an invoice.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone
